segments: Routing, robot and snow timing, staff dupes, and skips for a fast Black Ops III Origins run, built from the advanced route in the linked walkthrough. Puzzle solutions stay on the staff tabs.
GobbleGums: Raindrops, Extra Credit, Nukes, Perkaholic, Self-Medication.
Keep the Mauser. For tank-skip routes, Pack-a-Punch it into the Boomhilda before the Lightning section.
Set attachments for the VMP and M8A7; both are useful wall buys during the run.
Keep track of Mule Kick weapon order. The route intentionally manipulates staff slots later.
Round 3 snow is possible; either round 4 or 5 is guaranteed. Dig constantly even off-snow because failed digs improve later Ice-part odds.
Robots begin around 1:00 and repeat roughly every 2 minutes. The robot is decided about 20 seconds before it spawns.
Robot trios alter the next cycle timing by about 10 seconds. Round timing can be used to skip an unwanted trio cycle.
For this WR-style route, an early Odin at Gen 2 or missing both round-3 and round-4 snow is treated as a reset condition.
